items.title: GXVK: 3Dfx Glide API Implemented Atop Vulkan For Modern Usage
items.author: Michael Larabel
items.content: <article>The open-source D7VK project that implements the Direct3D 7 / 6 / 5 / 3 APIs atop the Vulkan API for faster, modern performance is out with a new release. This new D7VK 2.4 release came as a bit of a surprise since it was just last month D7VK announced its maturity status and more or less in maintenance mode. But brought up in today's D7VK 2.4 announcement is an even bigger surprise: there's now an implementation of the 3Dfx Glide API atop Vulkan...</article>

items.title: Linux Kernel Developers Considering Removal Of KGDB Debugging Functionality
items.author: Michael Larabel
items.content: <article>Merged to the kernel all the way back in Linux  2.6.26 in 2008 was KGDB for improving the kernel debugging experience. KGDB works in conjunction with the GNU Debugger (GDB) to debug the kernel in a similar fashion to user-space debugging. KGDB requires the use of a second computer connected via serial or network cable. KGDB isn't widely used in recent years and a patch was floated today to remove it from the Linux kernel...</article>

items.title: CachyOS vs. Fedora 45 vs. Ubuntu 26.10 Performance On AMD Ryzen 9
